problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 4 shipments through 4 distribution hubs.

Each shipment follows a predetermined route represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the package must be processed and the duration required for handling.
The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which hubs must process the shipment.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H2, 1) → (H1, 8) → (H3, 6) → (H4, 3)
* S2 follows the route: (H2, 9) → (H3, 7) → (H4, 9) → (H1, 9)
* S3 follows the route: (H1, 7) → (H3, 4) → (H4, 5) → (H2, 9)
* S4 follows the route: (H4, 1) → (H2, 1) → (H3, 3) → (H1, 5)

Each handling procedure must run continuously once initiated without interruption,
and each hub can only process one shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all shipments at the hubs
so that the total delivery completion time for all shipments is minimized.
